walk.environment:
Build: the read-only worktree /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/tree at 0deff9c4. It was never edited: git status is clean and HEAD is unchanged at the end. The server was run with uvicorn on the app object, never `python -m src.api.main`.

Store: /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/N/data/enc, a fresh seed.
- Seeded with OO_DB_PASSPHRASE='walk-pass-2026' set and OO_DB_PLAINTEXT unset: the default STATE C, plus concept_fixture.py run once.
- 462 articles. The file header is ciphertext.
- Booted with NEITHER variable set. /api/system/lock-state returned locked (/api/articles gave 503 to curl while locked), and the store was unlocked through the real #pw / #btn-unlock form.
- Seed date is 2026-09-27, so every fixture article falls in ISO week 39.
- Port 8915. Airplane mode throughout: the plane stays filled and /api/system/network returns online:false. No consent popup was raised on any path I walked, and "Go online" was never pressed.

Browser: Playwright, Chromium at /opt/pw-browsers/chromium, headless, with --disable-background-networking, --disable-component-update and --no-proxy-server, and the proxy variables unset. A Recorder logged page errors, console errors, responses ≥400, any off-loopback request, and a scan for visible undefined / NaN / null / [object Object].

Passes:
- 1440x950 in en, then fr, ar (RTL) and zh, plus ja where the row names it.
- One 375 px pass in en.

Stand-in for N13, which differs from the first walk:
- A second store, /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/N/data/old, was seeded by the pre-S8 code (a copy at /tmp/claude-0/walk/N/oldsrc; nothing was written there).
- It was served by the fixed tree on port 9015, then the real Settings "Re-index search" button was run.
- The real install's 2,000,000+ article corpus was not available.

Both servers were stopped by PID. Scratch is /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/N/:
- 106 screenshots in shots/.
- R-*.json results and rec-*.json recorder logs.

new_defects.title: Sentiment VADER caveat is English in every locale, even after a reload
new_defects.repro: Unlock, open ?analyze=climate, switch the language to fr, then reload the page. Open the Sentiment subtab. Repeat in zh and ar.
new_defects.expected: The visible VADER caveat, which must stay visible by default under the informed-consent rule, appears in the UI language, as in every other caveat on the row.
new_defects.actual: The caveat under 'Tonalité moyenne' / '平均语调' is the English _SENTIMENT_CAVEAT text in fr, ar, zh and ja, after a live switch and after a fresh reload alike.
new_defects.evidence: shots/N-fr-reload-sentiment.png; R-frtabs.json; R-live.json zh_reload_sentiment and zh_sentiment.
new_defects.root_cause_lead: src/analytics/queries.py:1909-1912 defines _SENTIMENT_CAVEAT, which has no key in any of the 12 locale files. src/static/app-analysis.js (Sentiment block, about :2270) renders it with esc(d.caveat || "") and no t(), so neither the server nor the walker translates it.

new_defects.title: Trend 'Counts' mode labels mention counts as articles
new_defects.repro: Open ?analyze=climate, go to Trend, and choose Counts (the default). Hover the column. Also try ?analyze=election.
new_defects.expected: The unit is mentions, as /api/insights/trend documents ('Mention volume over time') and as the Insights hover says ('22 mentions · 7 articles'), or the count is of articles if the label stays.
new_defects.actual: The hover reads 'climate: 22 articles · 09-21 00:00' and the legend 'n=1 · articles', under 'Article counts on a shared time axis.' The API for the same window returns total 22 mentions over 7 articles, so the chart shows a wrong fact of about 3x. 'election: 1 articles' shows the same unit error (plural aside).
new_defects.evidence: R-counts.json (API total 22 and articles 7 against the chart label); shots/N-trend-counts-climate-en.png.
new_defects.root_cause_lead: src/static/app-analysis.js about :626 and :636 builds the counts series with unit: t("articles") over pt.count. src/api/insights.py:1874 returns mention volume. Either the unit string or the series source is wrong.

new_defects.title: Live language switch leaves analysis panels in the previous language
new_defects.repro: Open ?analyze=climate, go to Articles, and click the per-form count. Switch en→fr from the top-bar language menu without reloading. Then go to Trend by language and switch fr→ar, and to Sentiment and switch again. Also open Settings Diagnostics and switch fr→ar.
new_defects.expected: Every visible panel repaints in the new language, as Keywords, the Watch list, the mindmap and the coach already do.
new_defects.actual: Articles after en→fr keeps 'Show:', '↕ “climate” count', 'language:', '160 Articles · Open an article…', 'Page 1 of 4 (160 Articles)', 'View:' and 'PUBLISHED ↓'. The tone chip still reads 'negative -0.57', the language-cell hover still says 'English', and the per-form readout disappears. Trend after fr→ar stays entirely French, and after en→fr it keeps 'View:', 'Chart data' and '7 articles in total, counted once each'. Sentiment keeps 'Mean tone' / 'English-scored (reliable)' in the old language. The Diagnostics re-index status stays French after fr→ar. A reload fixes all of it.
new_defects.evidence: shots/N-live-fr-articles.png, N-live-ar-trend.png, N-live2-fr-trend.png, N-live2-fr-sentiment.png; R-live.json (fr_live_articles, ar_live_trend_frleft); R-live2.json; R-final.json ar_status_before.
new_defects.root_cause_lead: The oo:langchange listener at src/static/app-boot.js:41 repaints only some surfaces. The Articles total, pager and facets, the Trend panel, the Sentiment panel and the Settings Diagnostics status are built from t() at render time and are not re-rendered, and the walker cannot map their already-translated strings back.

new_defects.title: Concept-map labels are 5–7 px at 375 px width
new_defects.repro: Set the viewport to 375x812 in en. Open ?analyze=climate, go to Mindmap, and choose Concept without enlarging.

recheck.summary:
I re-checked row N on my own fresh encrypted instance on port 8965. The store is /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/N-recheck/data/enc: default STATE C plus concept_fixture.py run once, seeded with OO_DB_PASSPHRASE set and OO_DB_PLAINTEXT unset, and the file header is ciphertext. I booted with neither variable set: lock-state returned locked and /api/articles gave 503. I unlocked through the real #pw / #btn-unlock form.

The whole run stayed in airplane mode. /api/system/network returned online:false, no consent popup was raised, and the coachmark only ever got "Not now". I recorded no page errors, no console errors, no browser HTTP responses >= 400, no off-loopback requests and no undefined/NaN/null tokens. The only 4xx/5xx in the server log is my own deliberate curl while the store was locked. The server (PID 30495) was stopped by PID. The worktree is still clean at 0deff9c4.

All 8 walker items are confirmed:
- **N11 step failure:** confirmed.
- **Sentiment caveat:** confirmed, and wider than reported. The Sources and Links caveats in the same window are also English in fr, so "as in every other caveat on the row" does not hold.
- **Trend "Counts" mislabel:** confirmed. I raise it to P1 because it shows a wrong fact: 22 mentions are labelled as 22 articles, while there are 7.
- **Live switch leaving panels stale:** confirmed.
- **Welded separators:** confirmed.
- **⛶ hover:** confirmed.
- **375 px concept-map labels:** confirmed, with one correction. On this build ⛶ does NOT make them legible; only the Text-size slider does.
- **Home briefing prose English:** confirmed. It is not the known law-card-title item: the briefing was generated fresh on this seed, and no locale has keys for these strings.

Scratch is /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/N-recheck/:
- Scripts: p1_en.py, p2_loc.py, p3_live.py, p4_cav.py.
- Results: R-p1.json … R-p4.json and rec-p*.json.
- 45 screenshots in shots/.
- Logs in logs/.

items.root_cause:
(a) src/analytics/queries.py:1909-1912 has no locale key, and src/static/app-analysis.js:2274 renders d.caveat without t().

(b) The colon or comma is hard-coded after a t() label instead of going through the keyed '{prefix}: {text}' frame (ooLabelHtml, src/static/app-core.js:45):
- src/static/app-shell.js:777
- src/static/app-analysis.js:692, :697, :1361, :1410-1411, :1941, :2290-2291
- src/static/app-boot.js:486, :499, :502

(c) The oo:langchange listener at src/static/app-boot.js:41 has no repaint for these panels.
items.suggested_fix: See the three item-level fixes below: key and t() the analysis caveats; route every 'label: value' through ooLabelHtml/ooLabelText, plus a keyed list separator; register repaints from retained payloads in the one oo:langchange listener.

items.ref: new:Sentiment VADER caveat is English in every locale, even after a reload
items.evidence:
After a fresh reload in each locale, the first .hint in #an-sentiment reads 'Tone is measured by VADER, an ENGLISH-lexicon method; scores for non-English articles are unreliable (see the English share). Counts only, never a verdict.' The labels beside it are translated (e.g. 'Positif', '正面', 'إيجابي', '肯定的').

Evidence: R-p2.json fr/zh/ar/ja .sentiment; R-p4.json; shots p4-fr-sentiment-caveat.png and p2-{fr,zh,ar,ja}-sentiment.png.

The defect is wider than reported. In fr the Sources caveat ('Volume and timing are exact counts; mean tone is VADER …') and the Links caveat ('Shared-origin structure, counts only …') are English too. The grep finds no key for any of the three in fr.json (R-p4.json).

This breaks the informed-consent rule that every caveat string ships in all 12 languages.
items.root_cause:
src/analytics/queries.py:1909-1912 (_SENTIMENT_CAVEAT), src/analytics/queries.py:2011 (sources caveat) and src/api/link_analysis.py:215 (links caveat) are English server prose with no key in any of the 12 locale files.

src/static/app-analysis.js renders them verbatim: esc(d.caveat) at :2274 (sentiment), :2322 (sources) and :2261 (links), with no t(). The i18n walker matches exact keys only, so nothing translates them.
items.suggested_fix: Add the three fixed caveat sentences as keys in all 12 locales and render them with esc(t(d.caveat)), the same way src/static/app-boot.js:506 already handles the keyword-stats caveat. Alternatively, have the endpoints return a caveat key the client translates.

items.ref: new:Trend 'Counts' mode labels mention counts as articles
items.evidence:
The same wrong unit appears in every locale. In en, ?analyze=climate → Trend → Counts (default) shows:
- hover 'climate: 22 articles · 09-21 00:00'
- legend 'climate n=1 · articles'
- caption 'Article counts on a shared time axis.'

The API for the same lens (/api/insights/trend?term=climate&expand=true&literal_cap=true) returns total 22 and articles 7.

With expand=false: total 9, articles 3.

The 'By language' view draws the same sums and labels them correctly as 'mentions' (eng 9, fra 7, …), with '7 articles in total, counted once each' beside it.

The Insights hover for the same term says '22 mentions · 7 articles', so two surfaces contradict each other.

Every locale shows the same wrong unit: fr 'climat: 22 articles', zh '22 篇文章', ar '22 مقالة', ja '22 記事'.

Evidence: R-p1.json (trend_hovers, trend_legend, api_trend_climate, api_trend_climate_literal, bylang_legend); R-p2.json trend_hover per locale; shots p1-trend-counts-climate-en.png and p1-trend-bylang-climate-en.png.

I rate it P1 under this walk's rubric ('wrong fact shown'): the chart states about 3x as many articles as exist. The walker filed P2.
items.root_cause:
src/static/app-analysis.js:628 and :637 give the Counts series unit t('articles'), and :705 adds the caption 'Article counts on a shared time axis.' The plotted value, however, is pt.count.

src/analytics/queries.py computes that as SUM(KeywordMention.count), i.e. mentions, in two places:
- the ring path: _mention_series, queries.py:939-957
- the single-keyword path: queries.py:1044-1052

_drawAnTrendByLang (app-analysis.js ~:748) labels the identical numbers unit t('mentions').
items.suggested_fix: Label the Counts series unit t('mentions') and change the caption to a keyed 'Mention counts on a shared time axis.' in all 12 locales. If an article count is wanted instead, add a server-side distinct-article-per-bucket series and chart that under the 'articles' label.

items.ref: new:Live language switch leaves analysis panels in the previous language
items.evidence:
Walk: en, ?analyze=climate → Articles → 'Count each form', then a live switch en→fr from the analysis tab's own top-bar menu (R-p3.json).

Articles after the switch:
- The labels stay 'Show:', 'source:', 'language:', 'View:'.
- The count button stays '↕ “climate” count'.
- The total stays '160 Articles · Open an article to read it…', and the pager 'Page 1 of 4 (160 Articles)'.
- The header stays 'Published ↓'.
- Row 1's tone chip stays 'negative -0.57', and the language-cell hover stays 'English'.
- The per-form readout (climate 156 · climat 3 · …) disappears: the forms slot becomes empty.
- The same holds after fr→ar.

Sentiment, rendered in en, keeps 'Mean tone: … English-scored (reliable)' after the fr and ar switches.

Trend (By language) while on the panel, switched fr→ar, stays French ('Affichage:', 'Données du graphique', '7 articles au total…', the French caveat), with a mixed 'التاريخ\tVALEUR' header. Leaving the subtab and returning repaints it in Arabic; opening Trend for the first time after a switch is correct.

Settings → Advanced → Diagnostics: the re-index status 'Articles vérifiés : 462 · réindexés : 0 …' stays French after a live switch to ar.

A reload fixes all of it, except the VADER caveat, which stays English regardless.

Shots: p3-live-fr-articles.png, p3-live-ar-articles.png, p3-live-fr-sentiment.png, p3-live-ar-trend-on-panel.png, p3-live-ar-trend-revisit.png, p3-fr-reindex-status.png, p3-ar-live-reindex-status.png.
items.root_cause:
The ONE oo:langchange listener at src/static/app-boot.js:41 registers analysis repaints only for:
- the cross-language rail (_anRepaintXLang)
- the near-duplicate note (_anRepaintDupNote)
- the price panel (_anRepaintPrice)

Nothing repaints the frozen t()/tf() frames of:
- the Articles list: src/static/app-analysis.js:2049-2062 with _anArtControls :1355-1370, facet labels :1410-1411, _anArtPager :1243, _anGroupByLangControl :1921/:1941, the tone chip :1292 and _anLangCell :1905
- the open Trend panel: drawAnTrend :666 / _drawAnTrendByLang
- the Sentiment block: :2272-2291
- the re-index status: src/static/app-diagnostics.js:297, textContent set once

_anRepaintXLang (app-analysis.js:1523-1532) rebuilds the rail from _crossLangNotice, which replaces the fetched per-form counts slot with an empty one.
items.suggested_fix:
Retain the last payloads and repaint from them in the same listener, with no fetch:
- re-render the Articles list from the last /api/articles payload
- call drawAnTrend() when #an-trend has been drawn
- re-render Sentiment from its retained payload
- rebuild the re-index status line from the last status/report

In _anRepaintXLang, keep the last concept-forms payload per slot and re-fill the new slot with _anFormCountsHtml(d) after the replace.

items.root_cause:
Hard-coded ': ' / ', ' after t() labels, in these places:
- src/static/app-shell.js:777 (`${t("Analysis")}: “${raw}”`)
- src/static/app-analysis.js:692 and :1941 (View), :697 (Overlay a commodity), :1361 (Show), :1410 (source), :1411 (language), :2290 (Mean tone), :2291 (English-scored)
- src/static/app-boot.js:486 (trend), :499 (', Association'), :502 ('with: ' and co.join(', '))

app-analysis.js never calls ooLabelHtml or ooLabelText (src/static/app-core.js:45-57), the helper the B14/Z3 fix introduced for exactly this.
items.suggested_fix: Build each label with ooLabelHtml/ooLabelText so the separator comes from the keyed '{prefix}: {text}' frame. For the palette row use a keyed frame such as tf('Analysis: “{q}”'). For the co-occurrence parenthetical and list, add keyed frames: '({n} articles, Association {pmi})' and a keyed list separator (', ' in en/fr, '، ' in ar, '，' or '、' in zh/ja).

items.ref: new:⛶ hover still says 'Enlarge the mindmap' while the map is enlarged
items.evidence:
In en, ?analyze=climate → Mindmap → Concept:
1. Before the click, ⛶ has title 'Enlarge the mindmap'.
2. After one click, the map is enlarged (.an-mm-big present), and hovering ⛶ opens the #oo-tip bubble reading 'Enlarge the mindmap'.
3. The button has no aria-pressed or state change.
4. A second click shrinks the map back (.an-mm-big absent).

Evidence: R-p1.json (enlarge_title_before, is_big_after_click, enlarge_tip_after, is_big_after_second_click); shot p1-mm-concept-enlarged-hover-en.png.
items.root_cause: src/static/app-analysis.js:1044 emits a fixed title="${esc(t("Enlarge the mindmap"))}" whatever _anMM.big is.
items.suggested_fix: Make the title state-dependent: t(_anMM.big ? 'Shrink the mindmap' : 'Enlarge the mindmap'), with the new key added in all 12 locales. Add aria-pressed="${_anMM.big}" so the state is also announced.

items.ref: new:Concept-map labels are 5–7 px at 375 px width
items.evidence:
At 375x812 in en, ?analyze=climate → Mindmap → Concept (not enlarged): the SVG is 301x204 px for a 680x460 viewBox. Rendered label heights (R-p1.json m375_concept):
- arms ('eng 3' … 'por 1'): 6-7 px
- leaves ('assembly', 'rapport'): 5 px
- centre 'climate': 9 px

The screenshot is illegible (p1-375-concept-en.png).

Correction to the walker: on this build ⛶ does NOT make it legible. The enlarged SVG is 487 px wide for a 1100 viewBox, the same 0.44 scale, so the labels stay 5-7 px / 9 px (m375_concept_big; p1-375-concept-big-en.png).

Only the 'Text size' slider at maximum reaches arms 12 px, leaves 9 px, centre 15 px (m375_concept_textmax).

The Map view is equally small: 4-9 px (m375_map).

There is no horizontal overflow (0).
items.root_cause:
src/static/app-analysis.js:1059 fixes the viewBox at 680 wide (1100 when big). :1067 draws it at width 100% (or W/680 × 100% when big, which by the B-batch design keeps exactly the normal scale). So the drawing scale is hostWidth/680, which is 0.44 at 375 px.

Label font sizes are in viewBox units: 13*scale at :1004, 9.5*scale at :1016, 17*scale at :1021. They render at 44% on a phone.
items.suggested_fix: On a host narrower than the viewBox, keep a minimum drawing width: render the SVG at max(hostWidth, 680) px inside the existing overflow:auto .an-mm-big box, opened on its centre. Alternatively, divide the font sizes by the rendered scale (host.clientWidth / W), with a floor of about 11 px, so the labels stay readable without touching the text-size slider.

items.ref: new:Home briefing summaries, ranking line and back-face caveats stay English after a fr reload
items.evidence:
After a reload in fr, zh, ar and ja, Home → Overview (R-p2.json home_cards and flipped_back_text) shows these in English:
- the rising card's summary 'Mentions of “climate” are running ~22.0× the prior-period rate (22 recent vs 0 before).'
- its back-face caveat 'A rising count reflects your source set, not the world; a ratio is not a significance test, and small samples are noisy.'
- the ranking line under every card: 'Ranked by a disclosed order (independent sources → sample magnitude → recency), never a score. This lead: 1 independent source(s); n=22 (magnitude tier 1/3); freshest evidence 1.0 day(s) old.'
- the overtold card's summary and caveat
- the method text ('Méthode : recent volume vs prior-period rate …')
- the type chips 'SOURCE LAUNDERING', 'LONELY SIGNAL', 'RECYCLED CLAIM', 'THROUGH TIME'
- the context card title 'Through time: this day in past years'

The card chrome around them is translated: 'Pourquoi est-ce que je vois cela ?', the plain-why sentence, 'Ouvrir le corpus', and the family caveat 'Une piste par famille…'.

This is not the known stored law-card-title item. The briefing was generated fresh on this same-day seed, loadBriefing re-runs on oo:langchange, and none of these strings exists as a key: grep finds 0 in fr.json and ar.json for the rising caveat and the ranking line.

Shots: p2-fr-home-card-back.png, p2-zh-home-card-back.png, p2-ar-home-card-back.png, p2-ja-home-card-back.png.
items.root_cause:
The producers write English prose:
- rising-card summary at src/briefing/producers.py:300-303 and caveat at :322-325, plus the young-corpus note at :110-115
- src/briefing/leads.py:97-106, where explain_order builds an English f-string with embedded numbers

Only titles have an i18n template (title_i18n/title_vars, src/briefing/card.py:191 and :293).

src/static/app-home.js renders these verbatim with no t()/tf(): card caveat at :1669, summary at :1705 (and :1285), order_explain at :1204, type chip c.type.replace(/_/g,' ') at :1683.
items.suggested_fix: Extend the title_i18n seam to summary_i18n/summary_vars and caveat_i18n (+vars), keep the young-corpus note as its own keyed sentence, and render them with tf() in all 12 locales. Ship order_explain's components (sources, n, tier, age) and build the line client-side from one keyed frame. Translate the type chip through a keyed map of card types.
